title: Torre Glòries

reconstruction.profile: Vertical lower cylinder transitions continuously into an elliptical crown; upper concrete shell ends at 115 m

reviewStatus: source-geometry; near/far and shared-material captures pending
limitations: Original 142044-triangle/16046604-byte master remains exactly reproducible from the unchanged global recipe, including 4,500 original reconstructed window cells and alpha louvres. Reviewed source/browser levels preserve the oval lower shaft, continuous rounded crown, irregular warm-red to cool-blue pixel composition and pale glazed dome with meridian/parallel framing. Opaque combined skin averages the visual contribution of the layered glass instead of submitting a second full transparent facade. Near levels retain tilted pale louvre strips and representative window pixels; distant levels average window coverage and remove small slats. Source dimensions and ellipse use map evidence. Crown profile with vertical-to-curved transition at 76.4 m, colored shell ending115 m, 25 tint families, pixel/windows/slat phase, oculus size and member pitches remain reconstruction, not surveyed fabrication dimensions. Supplier gives 25 colors versus current operator 26; supplier gives 144.4 m while rounded summaries give 144 m and original architect program 142 m. Pedelta webpage dome 32 m radius 35 m is inconsistent with mapped tower width; its radius is not used. Two shared 256px concrete/painted-metal graphs, opaque palette glazing, no embedded images or copied facade photo. The source master preserves 4,500 cells; reduced browser derivatives deliberately aggregate them and do not claim an exact opening count or schedule. Night LED show, observation interiors, external pavilion, underground auditorium, exact doorway and terrain slope excluded. Physical phone/laptop and dense-city timing remain unmeasured.
importReason: Preserve thin facade frames, panel joints and crown/antenna details until a measured LOD chain is authored.
